projects.name: VectorDB — RAG Pipeline & Vector Search Engine
details: Built a vector database from scratch in pure Python, implementing Brute Force, KD-Tree, and HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) nearest-neighbor search algorithms without external ANN libraries.

Architected a complete Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline — chunking documents, generating 768-dimensional embeddings with the local nomic-embed-text model via Ollama, indexing them with HNSW, and grounding llama3.2 responses in retrieved context.
Exposed the engine through a Flask REST API supporting semantic search, document insertion, deletion, and benchmarking endpoints, while managing dependencies with uv.
Built a 2D PCA visualization rendered on an HTML5 canvas for semantic clustering, and benchmarked HNSW against KD-Tree and brute-force search to demonstrate logarithmic-time retrieval performance.
